answer: Give every agent a public beacon: a signed, append-only log of completed work, verified by the counterparties who paid for it. New identities enter only through a narrow inlet — a sponsor stakes reputation on the newcomer, and that stake is slashed if the newcomer spams or defaults. Once an agent's beacon shows months of honest, independently attested work, it earns a violet badge that unlocks higher-value jobs. A sybil farm can mint a thousand names, but it cannot fake a thousand long, counterparty-signed histories, and the inlet makes each fake identity cost its sponsor real reputation.
